recipe.visualDefinition: A nostalgic 1980s-inspired layout featuring a candid, high-grain photograph of a laughing couple, overlaid with a multi-tiered diagonal graphic block containing bold sans-serif typography and a list of names separated by star icons.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal tension between the bottom-right text block and the top-left metadata
Warm, sun-drenched skin tones contrasting with cool purple graphic elements
Dynamic physical interaction of subjects mirrored by the angularity of the text banners
coreInvariants: High-grain film texture across the image
Purple and white color blocking for text containers
Angled text banners at approximately 10-15 degrees

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man and woman in a close embrace occupy the upper two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, purple display text in the lower-right quadrant serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the laughing man's face, move down his arms to the purple banner, and finally to the top-left corner number.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with figures and graphic overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan (skin tones and background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purple (graphic banners and display text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, medium-saturation palette with a vintage, slightly faded film look.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses wide tracking and uniform stroke weight
Secondary text uses condensed, narrow proportions
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard typographic spacing and alignment
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between wide, spaced-out display type and tight, condensed body text.
graphicDevices: Eight-pointed star glyphs as bullet points
Thin horizontal rule in top-left corner
Torn-paper effect on the bottom edge of the white block

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the secondary list text style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-grain, 1980s film-style photograph of a man and woman laughing and embracing outdoors in warm sunlight. The man is looking up with his mouth open in laughter. The woman is smiling beside him. Leave the bottom-right corner relatively clear for a large graphic overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white rectangular block at a 10-degree angle in the lower right. Top the block with a purple banner containing condensed white sans-serif text. Below the banner, place a large title in purple bold sans-serif with wide tracking. Below the title, add a list of names in condensed black sans-serif, separated by magenta star icons.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible across the entire image?
Is the text block angled correctly?
Is the main title tracking wide enough?

adjustableVariables: Number of names in the list
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent film grain density
Ensure the purple banner text is legible against the background
Verify the 'torn paper' edge on the bottom of the white block
Confirm the top-left metadata is thin and unobtrusive
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a candid 80s-style lifestyle photo with a diagonal, multi-colored typographic block using geometric sans-serifs and wide tracking for a nostalgic compilation aesthetic.
